card: SS-2026-11-W1-03 · reel_motion (code-rendered motion graphics, voiced), tier O30 (20 to 35 s) · job reach · belief B2 ('it isn't your fault: the cause is pieces that don't work together') · awareness problem_aware · cta_type send · hook_type hidden_cause · narrow product: clients who bought once don't come back because nobody invites them back; the fix is one message after the work is done in three parts (name the work, ask how it is going, leave the next step open). AI label on (AI voice).
facts:
- The owner's own words: 'klientët nuk kthehen' (clients don't come back); his fear: clients don't come back.
- His situation: busy, works in the business every day; pays for marketing pieces that don't connect.
- The three-part message is a process (a method), never a result. No claim that clients will come back.
- No numbers or counts except the post's own three parts. No names.
hook:
Visual from frame 1: a phone's chat list of past clients (generic, no app styling), each with a plain avatar circle (no names, no numbers). Every thread ends in the client's last bubble, a large readable 'Faleminderit!' (Thank you!), with nothing after it. Hold about 1.2 s, then the threads sink under new chats and drop off the screen.
Text hook (top third, 0-3 s): 'Klientët s'u kthyen. / A i ftoi kush?' [Clients didn't come back. / Did anyone invite them?]
Spoken L1 (fixed): see line 1.
structure: ST3 compact hidden cause, second-person narrator. One picture: the empty reply field under the client's 'Faleminderit!'. One timeline: the problem is seen in old chats; the fix applies to every job from now on, some time after the work. O30 rungs: recognition (L1), the cause in one picture line and the release (L2, L3), the fix: one short message (L4, L5), CTA send (L6).
actq: Would you send this reel to someone (the person who deals with your clients, a partner, a friend who owns a business)?
end_card: The red phone's chat list as in frame 1, but the top chat now ends in the owner's message, not in 'Faleminderit!'; text 'Ia dërgo këtë video personit që u shkruan klientëve.' and a small line 'që ta nisë pas punës së radhës' [so they start after the next job], plus the StraightScale wordmark. Held to 33.0 s.

lines.sq: Klientët e vjetër nuk kthehen, dhe ti mendon se gjetën dikë tjetër. Po a i ftoi kush të kthehen?
lines.en: Old clients don't come back, and you think they found someone else. But did anyone invite them back?
lines.super: 0-3 s text hook 'Klientët s'u kthyen. / A i ftoi kush?'; 3.0-8.3 'Mendon se gjetën dikë tjetër?' [You think they found someone else?]
lines.visual: Phone in a deep red case, generic chat list of past clients, every chat ending in a big 'Faleminderit!'; at 1.5 s they start to sink under new chats and drop off the bottom.

lines.sq: Hap bisedat e vjetra: mbarojnë me faleminderitin e klientit. Pas kësaj, asgjë.
lines.en: Open the old chats: they end with the client's thank-you. After that, nothing.
lines.super: 'Mbarojnë me faleminderitin e klientit' [They end with the client's thank-you]
lines.visual: One old chat is pulled back up and opened: the job photo, the client's 'Faleminderit!', and under it the empty reply field with a blinking cursor. Nothing else.

lines.sq: Nuk e ke fajin: puna mbaroi, dhe askush s'e vazhdoi bisedën.
lines.en: It's not your fault: the work ended, and nobody carried the conversation on.
lines.super: 'Askush s'e vazhdoi bisedën' [Nobody carried the conversation on]
lines.visual: Wide: the old chats side by side, each with the same empty reply field and blinking cursor under its 'Faleminderit!'.

lines.sq: Pra, ca kohë pas punës, dërgo një mesazh të shkurtër:
lines.en: So, some time after the work, send one short message:
lines.super: 'Ca kohë pas punës: një mesazh' [Some time after the work: one message]
lines.visual: A new chat at the top: a finished kitchen photo and the client's 'Faleminderit!'; a soft day-to-later light change (no dates); the owner's hands (seen from behind, at the showroom counter) tap the empty reply field on the red phone.

lines.sq: Si po të shërben kuzhina e re? Për çdo gjë, më shkruaj këtu.
lines.en: How is the new kitchen serving you? For anything, write to me here.
lines.super: The message itself on screen, its three parts tagged as they are said: '1 Puna' [the work] on 'kuzhina e re', '2 Si po shkon' [how it's going] on 'Si po të shërben', '3 Hapi tjetër' [the next step] on 'Për çdo gjë, më shkruaj këtu'
lines.visual: The hands fill that same reply field with the message and send it: the chat no longer ends at the thank-you.

lines.sq: Ia dërgo këtë video personit që u shkruan klientëve.
lines.en: Send this video to the person who writes to your clients.
lines.visual: Back to the frame-1 chat list (loop to the hook): the top chat now ends in the owner's message, not in 'Faleminderit!'. End card.
